# kala_customers (Data Source)

Lists customers in Kala. Customers are imported from e-conomic, which owns them, so they are read-only here by design rather than by API limitation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kala_customers" "all" {
  # search    = "baggins"   # filtered upstream
  # page_size = 200

  # Contact details are personal data and everything a data source exposes is
  # written to Terraform state, so they are withheld unless requested.
  # include_contact_details = true
}

# Check this before treating the list as the whole account: when the pagination
# cap is reached, `customers` is a subset and the provider also emits a warning.
output "complete" {
  value = data.kala_customers.all.complete
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_contact_details` (Boolean) Expose email, phone, address, zip, city, and ean. Off by default: these are personal data under GDPR and Terraform state must be treated as confidential.
- `page_size` (Number) Records fetched per request while paginating.
- `search` (String) Free-text filter applied upstream.

### Read-Only

- `complete` (Boolean) Whether the read covered every customer the account holds. **False means this list is a subset** -- the page cap was reached before the end of the data. Acting on a partial list as though it were whole is a bug.
- `customers` (Attributes List) The customers returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customers))
- `total` (Number) How many customers the account holds, as reported upstream.

<a id="nestedatt--customers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customers`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Street address. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `case_count` (Number) How many cases reference this customer.
- `city` (String) City. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `company` (String) Company name.
- `cvr` (String) Danish CVR company registration number.
- `ean` (String) EAN number used for invoicing. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `email` (String) Email address. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `first_name` (String) Contact's first name.
- `id` (Number) Kala's internal customer id. This is the value `kala_case` records reference, and the identifier to join on.
- `last_name` (String) Contact's last name.
- `number` (String) The customer number. A **string** on this API. Do not assume it equals `id`, and do not assume it matches the integer `number` webapiv2 returns for the same customer -- that equivalence is unverified.
- `phone` (String) Phone number. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `zip` (String) Postal code. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
